# Keybindings

Every row below is rendered from `hypr/config/software/keybinds.conf` by the
same parse that `Super + H` shows at runtime, so this file cannot disagree with
the bindings it documents. To change a binding, edit the config and regenerate:

```bash
./scripts/docs/generate-keybindings.sh
```

`test/test-docs.sh` fails when this file is out of date, so a stale copy cannot
be committed.

Two rows name a file rather than an application. `Super + Enter` and
`Super + B` run whatever `options/terminal` and `options/browser` contain, read
at Hyprland's parse time, so the answer is per-machine and the runtime
cheatsheet fills in your own. Everything else here is the same on every
checkout.

## Applications

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `Super + Enter` | Terminal (`options/terminal`) |
| `Super + E` | File manager (thunar) |
| `Super + N` | Text editor (nvim) |
| `Super + T` | Text editor (KWrite) |
| `Super + B` | Web browser (`options/browser`) |
| `Super + S` | Screenshot a region |
| `Super + Alt + S` | Screenshot a region and annotate |
| `Super + G` | Code editor (Zed) |
| `Super + K` | Calculator |
| `Super + A` | AI assistant sidebar |

## Window Management

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `Super + Q/W` | Close window |
| `Super + Shift + Q` | Exit Hyprland |
| `Alt + F4` | Close window |
| `Super + V` | Toggle floating |
| `Super + F` | Toggle fullscreen |
| `Super + Shift + F` | Fullscreen without gaps |
| `Super + O` | Toggle split direction |
| `Super + P` | Toggle pseudo-tiling |
| `Super + Shift + V` | Pin window (always on top) |

## Workspaces

|-----|--------|
| `Super + 1-9, 0, =` | Switch to workspace |

| `Super + Ctrl + 1-9, 0, =` | Move window to workspace silently |
| `Super + Left/Right` | Previous/next workspace |
